title: Role result — work (design §6.2, §7.5)
description: Passed verbatim to `claude --json-schema` for steps without `checks`, and used by the engine to re-check runs/<step>/<attempt>/result.json. Keeps to type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum so the CLI's structured output accepts it; the engine adds the rules a schema cannot say (outputs exist, request step names are catalog names — §4, §6.2 engine table). status is done or blocked only; concerns go to note.

status.description: done = the step's outputs are written. blocked = cannot continue; say why in blocked_by.

outputs.description: Paths of the declared output files you wrote.

requests.description: Procedure change requests (recorded only in stages 0–2, §6). Never put a command in a request.

blocked_by.description: Required (not null) when status is blocked.

note.description: Free text for humans and evolve. The engine never branches on it.
